title: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia, Circular Externa 031 de 2021 (revelación de información sobre asuntos sociales y ambientales, incluidos los climáticos, por emisores)
citation: Circular Externa 031 de 2021 (22 December 2021), adds Anexo 2 to Capítulo I, Título V, Parte III of the Circular Básica Jurídica
evidence: Circular text, last paragraph before the signature: "La presente Circular rige a partir de su publicación." Header "( Diciembre 22 )". The SFC page does not state the publication date, so the issue date is used. Opened https://www.superfinanciera.gov.co/loader.php?lServicio=Tools2&lTipo=descargas&lFuncion=descargar&idFile=1057619 on 2026-11-02.
notes: Replaces nothing; adds Anexo 2 and a numeral 3 to the Circular Básica Jurídica (Anexo 2 and the amended pages are in the zip idFile=1057620 and are not stored; the record is the circular itself, which carries the transition dates 2024 and the implementation plan of 10 February 2023). Languages stored on 2026-11-02: es (the circular) and en (translation record under CO-SFC-TRANSLATION: the English version the SFC publishes on the same page, idFile=1058633, which states it is not an official translation; it is the circular as issued, so its amendment state matches the stored version). The SFC page also lists a 10 October 2023 concept on applying IFRS S1 and S2 against this circular; it is not an instrument in scope. Whether later circulars amend it: I don't know.

title: Ley 1931 de 2018 (directrices para la gestión del cambio climático)
evidence: Art. 36: "La presente ley rige a partir de su promulgación"; published in Diario Oficial 50.667 of 27 July 2018 (SUIN: "DIARIO OFICIAL AÑO CLIV No. 50.667 27 DE JULIO DE 2018 PÁG. 7"; the Diario PDF cover reads "viernes, 27 de julio de 2018"). Opened the Diario PDF and https://lexis.minjusticia.gov.co/suin-search/api/documentos/30035792 on 2026-11-02.
notes: Record is the law as published in Diario Oficial 50.667. SUIN and Función Pública mark art. 33 modified by art. 262 of Ley 2294 de 2023 (destination of the PNCTE revenue); those consolidations are not stored because rows CO-SUIN-CONSOLIDATED and CO-FUNCIONPUBLICA-CONSOLIDATED are permission requested. Arts. 29 to 33 set up the cupos transables de emisión; the PNCTE decree is co-decreto-969-2026. Spanish is the only official language. No government English translation known on 2026-11-02: looked for in the SUIN index and the Diario Oficial (Spanish only), and on the Ministerio de Ambiente and Cancillería sites linked from SUIN. Text layer: pdftotext (default reading-order mode) of the Diario Oficial PDF, cut by the heading and the closing signature; the same cut in raw mode agrees word for word apart from page numbers and the column order of one tariff table.
